prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single grim medieval RPG dialogue head portrait, aimed at a 74 by 100 pixel logical canvas, transparent RGBA.
Input images: image 1 is ONLY this character's identity master (head, hair/headwear, face and clothing color identity). Images 2–5 are ONLY the approved Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore portrait style examples; never copy their identity, hair, age, clothing or face. Redraw the subject from scratch in this exact family of restrained, severe low-resolution character portraits. Do not crop or merely resample the old full-body figure.
Style: truly coarse low-resolution pixel-art clusters designed to read at 74x100, large angular nose and cheekbone planes, strong irregular but clean dark outline, broad contiguous shadow masses, limited flat desaturated colors (at most 32 visible temporary working colors), minimal narrow dark eye openings with only a very small dim brown/gray sclera pixel where necessary. No bright white anime eyes. No anti-aliased painted gradients, no smooth skin, no noisy single-pixel dithering, no tiny high-resolution illustrative texture. Use square stepped clusters rather than strokes.
Composition: head fills most of portrait; close head and extremely shallow shoulders, very short exposed neck (only 3–5 logical pixels), collar is only the bottom 10–14 percent of canvas, no chest. Three-quarter view slightly toward viewer's left. Head crown, ear, hair/headwear edges and any knot must all be complete with real transparent breathing space: at least 3 logical pixels above, 3 pixels at left/right and 2 pixels below all opaque parts, no clipping. Do not make the face small just to include torso. Face and expression must remain legible at 1x. Single isolated portrait, true transparent background, no scene, no labels, no text, no frame, no swatches, no other figures, no props or hands.

Subject: Madi, a woman around fifty, the lantern keeper of a roadside inn. Preserve the identity master: narrow long mature angular face, long prominent straight nose, gray-streaked dark hair parted and tucked under a light oatmeal/beige tied headcloth, small visible ear and compact back knot. Keep the WHOLE headcloth and knot. She is older than Mara/Leiya: defined drooping upper eyelids, modest crow's feet, lower cheek planes, thin compressed asymmetric downturned mouth, slight forehead worry crease. Warm but insistent, worried over accounts yet capable of firm boundaries, not kindly smiling and not villainous. Turn the source's large cartoon eyes into tiny hooded dark openings. Muted weathered warm skin. Narrow dark charcoal inn smock/apron collar with a little muted rusty-brown dress at the neck, matching the master color family and current dark-smock card. No lantern light effect; no idealized young beauty, no extra jewelry, no saintly glow. Distinctive longer narrow nose, mature sagging cheek shape and headcloth must survive.
